title: Tech Note: Cross Platform File Transfer Via FTP and Web Browser

historical_commentary.text: This note describes using TCP/IP-based FTP and a web browser to migrate large 4D Server structure and data files between Macintosh and Windows during a corporate platform consolidation; while cross-platform file transfer over TCP/IP remains conceptually standard practice, the specific FTP/browser-based transfer mechanics described are a dated, narrow solution superseded by today's far faster networking, cloud storage, and dedicated migration tooling.
related_updates: Modern network speeds, cloud storage, and dedicated backup/migration tools have made 1997-era FTP-and-browser-based large file transfer techniques largely obsolete for this use case
4D's own architecture, licensing, and platform-migration tooling have changed substantially since this note's mid-1990s context of full Mac-to-Windows organizational platform switches
